node.statement: Under the hypotheses of node 1, prove the stronger assertion that for every nonempty subset U of C there is a current reset isomorphism v_U:M_{|U|}->A_U with recorded ambient field epsilon_U:=W.L*epsilon, with A_U an extended epsilon_U-C*-algebra, epsilon_U=W.L*epsilon<=W.K_call*epsilon, d_U<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_U, and ||v_U(I_{M_{|U|}})-u_{A_U}||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon_U; taking U=C then gives node 1.
